description: Briefing Service publishes hourly LLM-ranked news briefings as structured JSON, e-ink pages, and a daily PDF from roughly 100 RSS feeds.

notes: initialize and tools/list are free; the hosted endpoint includes 25 free tool calls per IP per day, then x402 USDC on Base or a Reader key sent as Authorization: Bearer.
